TextView.android:text: Simulate a notification LED dot on AMOLED screens. You can customize size, per-app color, and position the LED dot anywhere including all 4 corners.
Choose which apps use the LED and customize their individual colors.
Assign custom LED colors and blink speeds to contacts across WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Discord, and Messages.
Quick-set to any corner, slide position, or drag directly on the screen:
Choose between a solid LED dot or an illuminated camera punch-hole ring:
Solid LED Dot: Displays a vibrant, solid circular indicator.
Control when the LED appears and how it reacts to phone usage:
Shows on lockscreen / screen off. Hides when phone is unlocked.
Cycles LED color every 2.5s when multiple apps have alerts.
Automatically turns off LED when notifications are cleared.
Screen OFF = pure black AMOLED screen + clock, battery & LED dot (double-tap to wake). Screen ON = floating LED dot.
Prevent OLED screen burn-in and save battery while asleep or in pocket:
Micro-shifts LED position by 2-3px every minute to protect OLED pixels.
Stops LED if notification is left unread.
Suppresses LED when phone battery is critical.
Turns off LED using proximity sensor when inside pocket or face-down.
Real-time alerts for battery charging, critically low battery, missed calls, and SMS:
Pulsing Amber while charging. Solid Green when 100% full.
Flashes Red rapidly when battery drops below 15%.
Heartbeat double-pulse in Crimson Red for missed calls.
Default color for SMS (Google Messages, Samsung Messages).
Master control, test simulator, and profile backup:
Toggle LED service on/off. Also accessible from Notification Quick Settings Tile.
Triggers a simulated message alert so you have 5 seconds to lock your screen and test AMOLED LED behavior.
Tip: The LED dot is a floating overlay. Touch and drag the dot directly on your screen to place it anywhere (including corners). Use STOP LED to turn it off.
